cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Let Them Keep Hope
cards.instruction: Hide discouraging information because you believe hope is the only thing keeping someone able to continue.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Let's pack your paintings for the last gallery. You've finally picked up a brush again.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: If the big gallery rejected me too, I'm done. Did they write?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Their letter can wait. This gallery still needs your best three.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Pick them, then. I can't face another envelope.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll handle the envelopes. You finish the blue one; there's still somewhere for it to go.

mechanism: A directs competent practical work while withholding discouraging information to protect B's ability to continue.
confusable: Generic encouragement differs from actively concealing discouraging material because B threatens to give up.
comparison: Gallery rejection threatens painting; an allotment wait threatens gardening and requires tangible interim space.
seedUse: Use the threatened creative work and covered queue number, retaining evidence of concealment rather than merely optimism.
